name: Novva West Jordan campus
notes: 175 MW campus per $2B construction loan announcement (Mar 2025); OCP listing says >180 MW critical load planned (https://www.opencompute.org/marketplace/ocp-ready-data-centers/novva-slc-salt-lake-city-ut-ocp-ready-for-hyperscale-east/); Phase 1 120 MW operating 2023 per Cleanview. On-site gas plant: ~200 MW approved Dec 2024 (Stacker/Utah News Dispatch); Baxtel cites Utah DAQ approval of 72 Jenbacher JGS 620 engines x 3.27 MW. Phases 2-3 expected complete 2026.
